content: अव्यथ {%a.%} .²1 Not giving or inflicting pain, merciful. .²2 Free from pain. .{@-थः@} [न व्यथते पद्भपां न संचलति व्यथ् भयचलवयोः अच्] A snake. .{@-था@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of two plants; Terminalia Citrina Roxb (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>हिरडा</ns>); and Hibiscus Mutabilis. .²2 Dry ginger. .²3 (<ab>Ved.</ab>) Firmness, steadiness.
